card.name: Split before S-words in drug terms
card.fires_on: The piece of text just before a word that starts with S, where the S-word has been split off, such as /S before uicidal, /s before almeterol, or -S before GLT2. Seen mostly in drug-label headings and drug names.

modes.label: Slash before S
modes.description: A slash-like split right after a heading word, with the next piece starting a word like suicidal.

modes.label: Inside combined drug names
modes.description: A split in fluticasone propionate/salmeterol, before the salmeterol part.
modes.example: one trial compared fluticasone propionate<</s>>almeterol inhalation powder to fl

modes.label: Split S in other terms
modes.description: A hyphen or space before an S that starts a term like SGLT2, psychosis or Southeast.

card.plain: It fires where a word starting with S is broken into pieces, as in suicidal, salmeterol or SGLT2.
